description: Status of a trigger armed with arm_price_trigger (free). Returns {id, status, symbol, direction, price, created_at, expires_at, fired_at, fired_price, delivered_at, cancelled_at, delivery_attempts, last_error}, where status is one of armed, fired_delivering, delivered, delivery_failed (after 5 webhook attempts), expired or cancelled (via disarm_price_trigger). Returns 404 if id is unknown or its payment never settled.
name: get_trigger_status
